Hi, Emma.

Oh, really?

It was so beautiful.

What did you see there?
I saw the Guest-Greeting Pine, the Sea of Clouds, lots of strange rocks, and many ancient buildings.

Thanks.
Wow!
That looks amazing!
Did you go with anyone?

lines.t: Everyone said they wanted to go again.
Cool!
I'd like to go too!
How about you, Emma?
Where did you go on holiday?
I went back to the US with my mum and sister.

lines.t: I see.
So, did you do anything interesting there?

lines.t: Yes,
I went to a strawberry festival.
The food was great!
Everything had strawberries in it.
I ate strawberry cookies and strawberry chocolates.
lines.zh: 我吃了草莓饼干和草莓巧克力。

lines.t: They were delicious!
That sounds fantastic!
Yeah, it was.
The festival was near my grandparents' house in Seattle too.
lines.zh: 那个节日活动也在我祖父母西雅图的家附近。

The 17th of July.
Today was our first day visiting Moscow.
lines.zh: 今天是我们游览莫斯科的第一天。

lines.t: The weather was fine and everyone felt excited to visit some famous places in Russia.
lines.zh: 天气很好，大家都为能参观俄罗斯的一些著名景点而兴奋。

lines.t: In the morning, we went to the Victory Museum.
lines.zh: 上午，我们去了胜利博物馆。

lines.t: The Russian people built this museum to remember their fight against the Nazis during World War II.
lines.zh: 俄罗斯人民建造这座博物馆，是为了纪念他们在第二次世界大战中与纳粹的斗争。

lines.t: As we walked through the halls, the tour guide told us stories about the war.
lines.zh: 我们穿过一个个展厅时，导游给我们讲了关于那场战争的故事。

lines.t: In one hall, I saw an artwork with thousands of glass "tears" falling down.
lines.zh: 在一个大厅里，我看到一件艺术品，成千上万颗玻璃“眼泪”落下来。

lines.t: It reminds us that war is terrible and peace does not come easily.
lines.zh: 它提醒我们，战争是可怕的，和平来之不易。

lines.t: We should not forget that.
lines.zh: 我们不应该忘记这一点。

lines.t: At noon, we had lunch at a restaurant near the park.
lines.zh: 中午，我们在公园附近的一家饭馆吃了午饭。

lines.t: I liked the ice cream there, so I ate a lot of it.
lines.zh: 我喜欢那里的冰激凌，所以吃了很多。

lines.t: But, during dinner, I didn't feel like eating because I felt sick.
lines.zh: 但是吃晚饭时我不想吃东西，因为我觉得不舒服。

lines.t: So now, I just want to get a good night's sleep.
lines.zh: 所以现在，我只想好好睡一觉。

lines.t: The 18th of July.
It rained last night, so this morning the air was fresh and cool.
lines.zh: 昨晚下了雨，所以今天早上空气清新凉爽。

lines.t: I felt much better today.
We took the Moscow Metro to travel around.
lines.zh: 我们乘坐莫斯科地铁四处游览。

lines.t: The metro stations are really beautiful.
Sometimes I felt like I was walking inside a palace.
lines.zh: 有时我觉得自己好像在宫殿里行走。

lines.t: After that, we went to Red Square.
We saw some fantastic buildings there.
lines.zh: 我们在那里看到了一些很棒的建筑。

lines.t: In the afternoon, we arrived at a school and met a group of Russian students.
lines.zh: 下午，我们到了一所学校，见到了一群俄罗斯学生。

lines.t: We played games and soon became friends.
lines.zh: 我们一起玩游戏，很快就成了朋友。

lines.t: Later, someone took out his accordion, and soon everyone got together to sing and dance.
lines.zh: 后来，有人拿出了手风琴，很快大家就聚在一起唱歌跳舞。

lines.t: We were so happy that we didn't notice the time.
lines.zh: 我们太开心了，都没注意到时间。

lines.t: It was such a good experience.
lines.zh: 这真是一次很好的经历。

lines.t: Dad, can I hang out with my friends after lunch?
lines.zh: 爸爸，午饭后我能和朋友们出去玩吗？

lines.t: Sorry, Jim, you have to pack up your things first.
lines.zh: 抱歉，吉姆，你得先把你的东西收拾好。

lines.t: But I want to spend time with them before we move.
lines.zh: 可我想在搬家前和他们待一会儿。

lines.t: I know, but we need to get ready before the movers come.
lines.zh: 我知道，但我们得在搬家工人来之前准备好。

lines.t: Can you sort your things into those boxes?
lines.zh: 你能把你的东西分类放进那些箱子里吗？

lines.t: After that, could I go out?
Yes. Remember to write "Jim's bedroom" on each box!
lines.zh: 可以。记得在每个箱子上写“吉姆的卧室”！

lines.t: No problem, Dad.
I love our new house.
The living room is so big!
Could we keep some fish here?
lines.zh: 我们可以在这里养些鱼吗？

lines.t: Well, Jim, that's a lot of work.
lines.zh: 嗯，吉姆，那可要做很多事。

lines.t: Can you take care of them every day?
Yes!
OK.
Now, could you please help me hang up the photos?
lines.zh: 现在，你能帮我把照片挂起来吗？

lines.t: Sure.
Our balcony is so big and gets a lot of sunshine.
lines.zh: 我们的阳台很大，阳光充足。

lines.t: Can I grow some flowers there?
lines.zh: 我可以在那里种些花吗？

lines.t: Yes, you can.
That's a great idea, Helen!
Mum, can I invite my friends to our new house?
lines.zh: 妈妈，我可以邀请朋友们来我们的新家吗？

lines.t: Yes, Peter, but help clean up first.
lines.zh: 可以，彼得，但要先帮忙打扫。

lines.t: Could you please sweep the floor?
I'll clean the bathroom.
OK, Mum.
Guess what!
Grandpa and Grandma are visiting us this weekend!
lines.zh: 爷爷奶奶这个周末要来看我们！

lines.t: Oh, great!
I can't wait to show them our new house!
lines.zh: 我等不及要带他们看我们的新家了！

lines.t: Yes, but now we need to get ready for their arrival.
lines.zh: 是的，但现在我们得为他们的到来做好准备。

lines.t: Can you help me clean up their room?
lines.zh: 你能帮我打扫他们的房间吗？

lines.t: But their room is already clean!
lines.zh: 可是他们的房间已经很干净了！

lines.t: Well, it's not "grandma clean" yet!
lines.zh: 嗯，还没达到“奶奶的干净标准”呢！

lines.t: Oh, OK.
Jim, can you help me put the new clock on the wall?
lines.zh: 吉姆，你能帮我把新钟挂到墙上吗？

lines.t: I bought it for Grandpa to see the time.
lines.zh: 我买它是为了让爷爷看时间。

lines.t: Sure, Dad.
Helen, can you move this chair to their room?
lines.zh: 海伦，你能把这把椅子搬到他们的房间吗？

lines.t: Grandpa likes reading books in front of the window.
No problem, Dad.
Can I put some flowers by the window?
lines.zh: 我可以在窗边放些花吗？

lines.t: Yes, good idea!
Grandma loves flowers.
Mum, could you take me to the flower shop later?
lines.zh: 妈妈，你待会儿能带我去花店吗？

lines.t: No problem.

Going Home for the Spring Festival
"It's almost the Spring Festival.
Can we go to Hainan for the holiday, Dad?"
lines.zh: 爸爸，我们放假能去海南吗？”

lines.t: "Not this time,"
Dad answered with a smile.
"We're going to your mum's hometown!"
Soon the day of our family trip came.
lines.zh: 很快，我们全家出行的日子到了。

lines.t: We got up very early in the morning to catch the train.
lines.zh: 我们一大早就起床去赶火车。

lines.t: The train journey took more than five hours, and then we changed to a bus to get to my grandparents' village in the afternoon.
lines.zh: 火车坐了五个多小时，然后我们换乘公交车，下午到了外公外婆的村子。

lines.t: At the end of the road, I saw Grandpa and my little cousin standing in the cold wind waiting for us.
lines.zh: 在路的尽头，我看到外公和我的小表弟站在寒风中等我们。

lines.t: We walked quickly to greet them.
lines.zh: 我们快步走过去和他们打招呼。

lines.t: Grandpa helped us pull the heavy luggage into the house.
lines.zh: 外公帮我们把沉重的行李拖进屋里。

lines.t: "Ah, home again!"
said Mum with a smile on her face.
Grandma, my aunt, and my uncle were busy cooking dinner in the kitchen.
lines.zh: 外婆、舅妈和舅舅正在厨房里忙着做晚饭。

lines.t: They were very happy to see us.
lines.zh: 他们见到我们非常高兴。

lines.t: After a little while, my parents went to the kitchen to help.
lines.zh: 过了一会儿，爸爸妈妈去厨房帮忙。

lines.t: "Could you bring Wenwen her favourite snacks?"
lines.zh: “你能把文文最爱吃的零食拿来吗？”

lines.t: Grandma asked Grandpa.
I shared the snacks with my cousin and told Grandpa about school.
lines.zh: 我和表弟分享零食，还给外公讲学校的事。

lines.t: He was happy to hear I was doing well at school.
lines.zh: 听说我在学校表现很好，他很高兴。

lines.t: When dinner was ready, I asked, "Can I help?"
lines.zh: 晚饭做好时，我问：“我能帮忙吗？”

lines.t: "You can set the table,"
Dad said. We then enjoyed all the delicious food.
lines.zh: 爸爸说。然后我们享用了所有美味的饭菜。

lines.t: the familiar taste of home!"
said Mum.
During the dinner, my uncle told us some jokes and we had a good laugh.
lines.zh: 吃饭时，舅舅给我们讲了些笑话，我们开怀大笑。

lines.t: Several days later when we were leaving, Grandma held my hands and asked us, "Will you come home more often?"
lines.zh: 几天后我们要走时，外婆握着我的手问我们：“你们会常回家吗？”

lines.t: Mum nodded, with tears in her eyes.
lines.zh: 妈妈点点头，眼里含着泪水。

lines.t: Chen Jie, did you hear about the school music festival?
lines.zh: 陈杰，你听说学校音乐节的事了吗？

lines.t: Yeah, it sounds fun.
lines.zh: 听说了，听起来很有意思。

lines.t: Why don't you perform?
You play the Chinese flute better than anyone else in our music club.
lines.zh: 你的笛子吹得比我们音乐社任何人都好。

lines.t: Well, I'm afraid of performing alone.
I'm not as outgoing as you.
But you work harder than me.
And last week you played a really beautiful song!
lines.zh: 而且上周你吹了一首非常好听的曲子！

lines.t: You liked it?
Maybe we could play it together!
lines.zh: 也许我们可以一起演奏！

lines.t: Great idea!
I loved your performance!
You two did a wonderful job!
Thank you!
Look, it's time for Ella and Emma's show!
lines.zh: 看，该埃拉和埃玛表演了！

lines.t: Is that Ella singing?
No, that's Emma.
Emma is taller than Ella.
And she sings louder than Ella.
lines.zh: 而且她唱歌比埃拉声音大。

lines.t: Look! That is Ella dancing.
Her hair is longer than Emma's.
They both dance well,
but I think Ella dances better than her sister.
lines.zh: 但我觉得埃拉比她姐姐跳得更好。

lines.zh: 你们去年和今年都参加了音乐节。

There are more students and more activities this year.
lines.zh: 今年的学生更多，活动也更多。

lines.t: I think it is more colourful than last year.
twins, you look very similar.
lines.zh: 双胞胎姐妹，你们长得很像。

lines.t: How are you different?
I'm a little quieter than Ella. And she is funnier than me.
lines.zh: 我比埃拉安静一点。她比我更风趣。

lines.t: Emma always gets up earlier than me.

I like reading.

We Can't Live Without Bees
Imagine you go to the supermarket in your area, but there are almost no fruits, vegetables, honey, milk, eggs, or chocolate.
lines.zh: 想象一下，你去附近的超市，却几乎没有水果、蔬菜、蜂蜜、牛奶、鸡蛋或巧克力。

lines.t: How would you feel?
Disappointed?
Angry?
Sad?
At this moment you realize people, plants, and animals are all connected.
lines.zh: 此刻你会意识到，人、植物和动物都是相互联系的。

lines.t: We need each other to live, and bees are one of the best examples of this connection.
lines.zh: 我们相互依存，而蜜蜂就是这种联系的最好例子之一。

lines.t: Bees are very hard-working animals, and their greatest work is pollination.
lines.zh: 蜜蜂是非常勤劳的动物，它们最伟大的工作就是授粉。

lines.t: On one trip, they often visit 50 to 100 flowers.
lines.zh: 一次出行，它们常常要拜访50到100朵花。

lines.t: As they fly from one flower to another, they take pollen with them.
lines.zh: 当它们从一朵花飞到另一朵花时，就把花粉带了过去。

lines.t: This action helps plants grow.
lines.zh: 这一行为有助于植物生长。

lines.t: In fact, without their work, about 80 per cent of the plants in the world cannot grow.
lines.zh: 事实上，没有它们的工作，世界上大约80%的植物都无法生长。

lines.t: For this reason, many scientists believe that bees are the most important animals on this planet.
lines.zh: 因此，许多科学家认为蜜蜂是这个星球上最重要的动物。

lines.t: Bees are also one of the most interesting animals in the world.
lines.zh: 蜜蜂也是世界上最有趣的动物之一。

lines.t: For example, they work hard together to make their homes.
lines.zh: 例如，它们齐心协力地建造自己的家。

lines.t: In order to store honey, they create honeycombs.
lines.zh: 为了储存蜂蜜，它们建造了蜂巢。

lines.t: Another interesting thing about bees is how they communicate.
lines.zh: 关于蜜蜂另一件有趣的事是它们怎样交流。

lines.t: When a bee finds new food, it uses a dance to tell the others where and how far away the food is.
lines.zh: 当一只蜜蜂找到新的食物时，它会用舞蹈告诉其他蜜蜂食物在哪里、有多远。

lines.t: Bees play an important part in the ecosystem of our planet.
lines.zh: 蜜蜂在我们星球的生态系统中发挥着重要作用。

lines.t: However, the number of bees is dropping, and scientists are worried.
lines.zh: 然而，蜜蜂的数量正在减少，科学家们很担忧。

lines.t: Bees need our help, and there is a lot we can do.
lines.zh: 蜜蜂需要我们的帮助，我们能做的有很多。

lines.t: Think about what you can do to protect one of the most amazing animals on earth.
lines.zh: 想一想你能做些什么来保护这种地球上最神奇的动物之一。

lines.t: Every time I sit at the table, after cooking for my family, we create memories.
lines.zh: 每次我为家人做完饭坐到餐桌旁，我们都在创造回忆。

lines.t: The smells and the food's taste, along with our conversations, connect us to each other.

lines.t: What wonderful memories I have!
lines.zh: 我有多么美好的回忆啊！

lines.t: One of my favourite memories is my grandmother's pumpkin pie.
lines.zh: 我最美好的回忆之一是奶奶做的南瓜派。

lines.t: She always made it in autumn, when the weather got colder.
lines.zh: 她总是在秋天天气转凉时做南瓜派。

lines.t: Her friendly kitchen was the perfect place to warm up and enjoy a taste of the changing seasons.
lines.zh: 她温馨的厨房是暖和身子、品尝四季变化滋味的绝佳地方。

lines.t: I still remember the days when the smell of cinnamon filled the room with sweetness.
lines.zh: 我仍然记得那些日子，肉桂的香味让屋子里充满了甜蜜。

lines.t: Now, every time I smell cinnamon, I think of my grandmother's pumpkin pie.
lines.zh: 现在，每当我闻到肉桂的味道，我就会想起奶奶做的南瓜派。

lines.t: My grandmother told me about her first pumpkin pie.
lines.zh: 奶奶给我讲过她做的第一个南瓜派。

lines.t: When she was a college student in the US, she stayed with a host family.
lines.zh: 她在美国读大学时，住在一个寄宿家庭里。

lines.t: One year around Thanksgiving, the hostess taught her how to make a pumpkin pie.
lines.zh: 有一年感恩节前后，女主人教她怎么做南瓜派。

lines.t: Many years later, she taught me how to make it too.
lines.zh: 许多年后，她也教会了我怎么做。

lines.t: My grandmother loved learning how to make food from other cultures.
lines.zh: 奶奶喜欢学做其他文化的食物。

lines.t: "It's my way of making friends from around the world," she said.
lines.zh: “这是我结交世界各地朋友的方式。”她说。

lines.t: Grandmother taught me the secret to cooking: Cook with love.
lines.zh: 奶奶教给我烹饪的诀窍：用爱做饭。

lines.t: Thanks to my grandmother, I love to try new food and new recipes from other countries and cultures.
lines.zh: 多亏了奶奶，我喜欢尝试其他国家和文化的新食物、新菜谱。

lines.zh: 最后，让派冷却至少一个小时再吃。

Making Resolutions
Do you know what a resolution is?
A resolution is a promise that you make to yourself.
lines.zh: 决心是你对自己许下的承诺。

lines.t: People make resolutions to improve their life.

After all, the start of the year is often a perfect time for making resolutions.

lines.t: Resolutions can be about anything.

lines.t: To make your resolutions work, you need to plan them wisely.

lines.t: Always make sure your resolution is possible to achieve.

lines.t: Try to set mini-goals to help you achieve your resolution.

lines.t: And if you don't want to forget your resolutions, write them down.

lines.zh: 但如果我们在电话里吵得更厉害怎么办？

lines.t: If you stay calm and say sorry, it will help.
lines.zh: 如果你保持冷静并道歉，会有帮助的。

lines.t: If it is still hard to talk, take a break.
lines.zh: 如果还是很难沟通，就先冷静一下。

lines.t: Meet when you're both ready.
lines.zh: 等你们都准备好了再见面。

lines.t: I'll call and try to meet. Because friendship is important.
lines.zh: 我会打电话，争取见面。因为友谊很重要。

lines.t: Thanks for the advice!
You're welcome.
How to Make a Better Conversation
Do you get nervous when you talk to someone?
lines.zh: 你和别人说话时会紧张吗？

lines.t: Do you find it hard to have a conversation with a stranger?
lines.zh: 你觉得和陌生人交谈很难吗？

lines.t: If you have such worries, it is time for you to learn some more conversation skills.
lines.zh: 如果你有这样的担心，是时候学一些交谈技巧了。

lines.t: Here are some tips for making better conversations.
lines.zh: 这里有一些让交谈更顺利的小建议。

lines.t: Listen carefully and show interest in others.
lines.zh: 认真倾听，对别人表现出兴趣。

lines.t: One of the most important things is to listen to the person you speak to.
lines.zh: 最重要的事情之一就是倾听和你说话的人。

lines.t: If you are a good listener, you will find some good points to ask questions about.
lines.zh: 如果你是一个好的倾听者，你会找到一些值得提问的好话题。

lines.t: For example, if someone tells you their hobby and you can ask questions about it, they will surely be happy to continue the conversation.
lines.zh: 例如，如果有人告诉你他们的爱好，而你能就此提问，他们肯定会很乐意继续聊下去。

lines.t: Some of the best topics might be the weather, sports, music, films, food, or travel.
lines.zh: 最好的话题可能是天气、体育、音乐、电影、食物或旅行。

lines.t: However, it is impolite to ask someone's age, weight, or other personal information.
lines.zh: 然而，询问别人的年龄、体重或其他个人信息是不礼貌的。

lines.t: Also, if you don't agree with others, don't argue with them.
lines.zh: 另外，如果你不同意别人的意见，不要和他们争吵。

lines.t: Just move on to another topic.
Be honest and sincere.
If you have no idea of a subject, just say "I don't know much about it."
lines.zh: 如果你对某个话题一无所知，就说“我对此了解不多”。

lines.t: If you want to make the other person happy, mention his or her strong points. But don't just pretend to be nice, because people can find out you are not telling the truth.
lines.zh: 如果你想让对方高兴，就提提他或她的长处。但不要只是假装友好，因为别人能看出你说的不是真话。

lines.t: Pay attention to your body language.
Sometimes it is just as important as your words.
lines.zh: 有时它和你说的话一样重要。

lines.t: Don't be nervous.
Stand up straight, smile, and be yourself—you
lines.zh: 站直，微笑，做真实的自己——你

lines.t: yourself—you have a lot to offer.
If you really work at it, you will find having conversations much easier.
lines.zh: 只要你真正下功夫，你会发现交谈容易多了。
